mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 59 degrees at Verona Community Park. Under the current Waxing Gibbous moon, we have a unique treat as the International Space Station will be visible tonight at 3:24 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and tracking toward the Fitchburg and Madison area at about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is currently hiring an Engineering Technician to help manage infrastructure and utility projects, with a deadline to apply by September 20. Additionally, the city is offering a rain barrel rebate program for properties in the stormwater utility, providing a 30 dollar credit for qualifying installations.

We have plenty going on in Verona. Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or take your kids to the girls try hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, Insight Wellness is hosting yoga classes.
Looking at the weekly report, on August 15, an officer conducted a traffic stop involving a 44-year-old woman found unresponsive behind the wheel, which led to an arrest for a first offence O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open at 10:00 AM.
